description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Messages class, which manages a collection of message hashes with types such as debug, info, warn, and error. It provides methods to add, clear, retrieve, and iterate over messages.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Messages
classes.description: A class for managing a list of messages with different severity types, supporting addition, retrieval, and iteration.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and returns a new Messages object.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a message to the collection. Accepts a hash reference, a string, or a hash with 'type' and 'text/html'.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all messages from the collection.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Returns an array reference of all messages.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next message in the collection, removing it from the list.
